scenes.vo: Tadao Ando never studied architecture. He taught himself, and made light his only decoration.
His first famous house gives the street one concrete wall, and a single door.
Here, the glass wall slides away, and the cross stands in a lake.
At this temple, you walk down a stair, straight through a lotus pond.
And this museum is buried inside a hill, on an island.

scenes.title: All 26 on the site
scenes.vo: All twenty-six of his buildings are on the site.

caption:
A former boxer with no degree became the master of concrete and light.

Tadao Ando taught himself architecture. Then he cut a cross into a wall and let the sun do the rest.
